title: Ascension Video / Cultural Echo Synchronism Ledger
status: open-source synchronism research; no copying claim without timestamped paired evidence
purpose: Track cases where Tim Dooley introduced an unusual word, symbol, model or spiritual-development motif and later ascension/spiritual/culture videos appeared to use closely related language or imagery. The ledger distinguishes coincidence, shared esoteric vocabulary, algorithmic convergence, zeitgeist diffusion, direct exposure and actual copying.
core_claim_boundary: A later video resembling Tim's language is not evidence that its creator watched Tim. To argue influence, recover both sides: Tim's earlier timestamped source and the later video's publication timestamp/transcript, then score semantic specificity, rarity, timing, source independence and plausible exposure path.

hypothesis_classes.description: Both Tim and a video draw independently from common New Age/esoteric language: ascension, awakening, moon, portal, timeline, frequency, vibration, divine feminine, higher dimensions. Default explanation unless stronger evidence appears.
Tim and creators react to the same cultural events, platform trends, astrology/esoteric cycles, AI discourse or geopolitical news, producing similar language independently.
Recommendation systems expose adjacent communities to similar source material, causing language convergence without direct Tim→creator transfer.
Tim's language diffuses through intermediaries, clips, trolls, commentary, chats, AI outputs or subculture and reaches a creator without attribution.
Creator/channel plausibly watched Tim or a derivative source and then reused a distinctive motif or phrase.
Requires strongest evidence: distinctive rare phrase/structure, clear priority, close temporal interval, plausible access, and substantial semantic/order overlap.

scoring.priority_lead_days: later timestamp minus Tim timestamp; negative invalidates Tim-priority claim
scoring.rarity_0_5: How unusual is the phrase/cluster outside Tim? Exact 'Spudlight' scores high; 'ascension' low.
scoring.semantic_overlap_0_5: From generic thematic similarity to same unusual sequence/relationship.
scoring.structural_overlap_0_5: Same relational chain, e.g. spiral→ladder→axis→north→still center, rather than shared nouns.
scoring.temporal_proximity_0_5: hours/same day > days > weeks > months > years.
scoring.exposure_path_0_5: No known contact to direct subscription/chat/clip/repost evidence.
scoring.independent_source_quality_0_5: Original upload metadata/transcript > archive repost > recollection.
scoring.negative_control: Track videos Tim watched that did NOT echo his language and Tim concepts that never appeared later; otherwise pattern detection will inflate apparent hits.

interval_bands.interpretation: Potentially striking if language is rare and publication timestamp is trustworthy; still not proof of influence.
Could reflect diffusion, shared trend or coincidence.
Best used for broader paradigm convergence, not copying claims.

public_web_observation_2026_09_09.boundary: The archive is adversarial commentary and should be treated as source material/transcript locator, not neutral interpretation.
